Assistant: Everything is confirmed. The critical context: **this PR is already merged to master** (by the owner's own account, `pablof7z`), and Fable's clincher checks out — the merge changed the nips.md notes column from *"Requires product/architecture decision before activation"* → *"Requires activation work before any support claim,"* erasing the deferral marker. [...] - **A (blocking-question):** The doc's "Decision Summary" hard-picks the milestone shape ("the first wallet milestone **is** Cashu/nutzap") — exactly the choice you deferred twice on #1001 ("do not re-ask or re-litigate"). The merge also flipped the nips.md matrix note from *"requires product/architecture decision"* → *"requires activation work,"* erasing the deferral marker. Since you merged it, this may be a deliberate reversal — I asked you to either record that on #1001 or reframe the doc as conditional, because right now the doc and the issue contradict each other. [...] `ACTION_LEGACY_NWC_CONNECT`/`ACTION_LEGACY_NWC_DISCONNECT` deleted; there's now exactly one `ACTION_NWC_CONNECT`/`ACTION_NWC_DISCONNECT` pair using nmp-nip47's real current names (`nmp.wallet.connect`/`nmp.wallet.disconnect`). I did NOT rename these to the aspirational `nmp.wallet.nwc.connect`/`nwc.disconnect` from the design doc's Product Surface list, because nothing implements that name today — nmp-nip47 is the only real backend, under the current names. Renaming requires moving nmp-nip47's ActionModule + wire-schema registration, which is epic #2864 Phase 2 (NWC consolidation) and crosses into nmp-nip47's lane. `pay_invoice` was untouched — it's already the single canonical name per the design doc, not an alias pair. Added a test (`no_action_namespace_is_duplicated_as_a_compatibility_alias`) asserting no two wallet action constants share a string value. [...] **F3 (LOW-MED) — `docs/nips.md:54` NIP-60/61 row is stale.** Still says "future `nmp-wallet` composition crate **not yet added**" and "No product/UI surface exists yet", and lists #2870 as open follow-ups. As of #2876, nmp-wallet exists (Phase-1 journal spine); #2870 is closed (fixed by #2874). Update the row. [...] Assistant: Now the NMP mint-discovery issue.
 [...] **NMP mint-discovery issue filed** — [#2880](https://github.com/pablof7z/nostr-multi-platform/issues/2880): Support NIP-87 (Ecash Mint Discoverability) — kind:38172 announcements / kind:38000 recommendations. Scoped post-v1, referenced from nutsack's spec as a future enhancement (the MVP just pins testnut). [...] - Filed #2882 — release-classify nmp-wallet (`[[private_packages]]`) + nmp-nip60 (not a `[[public_crates]]` entry) so external consumers can git-rev pin. This is NOT covered by #2864 (which builds the product but doesn't make it consumable).
- Commented on epic #2864 — nutsack as first external consumer; offered the headless round-trip as the W8/W9 acceptance vehicle; flagged the testnut auto-settle contract question for W2 (does the Cashu backend drive a value-less quote through deposit_quote/complete_deposit with no Lightning leg?). [...] SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT BLOCKER to a green end-to-end run: #2882 (release classification). Until nmp-wallet and nmp-nip60 are `[[public_crates]]`, nutsack cannot pin them at all — this blocks everything regardless of how much of #2864's W1–W11 backend is built. Natural gate: flip classification once Wave C (W4–W7) gives the crate a real action/projection surface.
